name: Stage_Events
label: Stage Events
_about: The event log (spec 05 Shared Engines 04, 01 Database section 8). One row each time a record enters a stage. Written by the server only. A record that goes back gets a new row with Visit_No + 1; the stamp on the record itself is the first one and is never overwritten.

fields.name: Record_No
fields.label: Record No
fields.helpText: The number staff quote, e.g. SHP-00012.

fields.name: Reported_At
fields.label: Reported At
fields.helpText: When the system was told (server time).
